messages.subject: Re: gl2gds
parts:
Hi Gabriella,

Can you try:

library(dartR)
library(GENESIS)
library(GWASTools)
t1 <- platypus.gl
t1 <- gl.filter.callrate(t1,threshold = 1)
t1$other$loc.metrics$chromosome <- 1
t1$other$loc.metrics$position <- 1:nLoc(t1)
res <- gl2gds(t1,outpath = getwd(),snp_pos = "position",snp_chr = "chromosome",chr_format = "numeric")
geno <- GdsGenotypeReader(filename = "gl_gds.gds")
genoData <- GenotypeData(geno)
pcair(genoData)

Cheers,
Luis

messages.author: 722521532a54784f
messages.subject: Re: gl2gds
parts:
Hi Luis,
thank you for this code as well.

However, I ended up not needing it at the moment, as I got a reply from the GENESIS developers -->https://support.bioconductor.org/p/9155031/
Apparently, similarly to the SNPRelate::snpgdsIBDMLE() function, even in GENESIS::pcair() there is an argument "autosome.only" that can be set to FALSE, and this can prevent the pcair() function from eliminating all SNPs without a defined chromosome position such as in my case.
So, when I used this argument ("autosome.only" = FALSE) and set it to "false", the function works.
I just thought it would be useful to other people in the group to know this.

However, thank you anyways for the code, as it might be useful in other cases!
On this note, is it possible for me to add in a similar way some of the information present in my genlight@other$ind.metrics into the GDS file during conversion from genlight to GDS, with dartR::gl2GDS?

It would be useful if this could be possible somehow.
Thank you for all your constant help!
Best,
Gabriella
